Composition: this is a NEW visual interpretation of the same theme, with different setting, viewpoint and arrangement from a generic sunrise landscape. Use a sufficiently WIDE view so every main object is fully BELOW that midpoint. Keep the main subject/meaningful details in the lower LEFT area. Leave the lower-right 40% width by 40% height free of essential objects because a camera inset covers it. Maintain a unified full-bleed image, not a split layout or empty rectangle. Atmospheric spaciousness, polished appealing detail in the subject area.
Constraints: original Christian worship imagery, peaceful, reverent and hopeful. No words, lettering, typography, numbers, watermarks, branding, border, frames, collage, contact sheet, slide text or UI. No readable writing on objects. No graphic suffering or violence. Generate exactly ONE image.
review: accepted; visual composition/style review and 1280x720 dimensions verified
